title: Doodling Dumbo Octopus
statement: In a lantern-lit twilight of deep blue water, this small, ear-finned octopus drifts between shelves of carefully sorted shells, pausing to trace slow, looping patterns in the white sand with the tip of one curious arm. It blushes a soft peach glow whenever someone lingers at the glass, and no two of its doodles have ever been the same.
